selection_policy.objective: Highest average net R after hypothetical 0.05R round-trip cost

assumptions.entry: Signal-bar close; stop checks start next candle.
assumptions.cost_model: Sensitivity deductions of 0, 0.02, 0.05, or 0.10 initial-risk R per round trip; not a broker-specific quote.
assumptions.historical_test: Test segment is diagnostic only because it was inspected earlier.
